name: io.github.noahowsh/strikerapi
title: StrikerAPI
description: Premier League, MLS and European football: lineups, shot maps, xG, tables and odds. REST and MCP.

headers.name: x-api-key
headers.description: Your StrikerAPI API key. Get a free key with 500 credits at strikerapi.com/signup

tools.name: list_teams
tools.description: Club ids, abbreviations and colours for a season

tools.name: list_games
tools.description: Fixtures and results by season, stage, date, range or club

tools.name: get_schedule
tools.description: Upcoming fixtures with the median three-way line across sportsbooks

tools.name: get_standings
tools.description: The league table: points, deductions, goal difference, home and away, form

tools.name: get_head_to_head
tools.description: Two clubs' meetings: record, goals and every result

tools.name: get_game
tools.description: One match: score, both box scores, every player's line, key events, each book's line

tools.name: get_lineups
tools.description: Formations, starting XIs, benches and substitutions with minutes

tools.name: get_player
tools.description: Profile, per-season totals and per-90 rates, last 10 matches

tools.name: get_leaders
tools.description: Season leaders: goals, assists, shots, xG, cards, saves

tools.name: get_team_stats
tools.description: Per-match averages: goals, xG, shots, possession, passing, discipline, for and against

tools.name: get_odds
tools.description: Every sportsbook's three-way moneyline, goal handicap and total for a match (5) or a day (10), with results

tools.name: get_events
tools.description: Match events: goals, cards, substitutions, shots with location and xG, fouls, corners

tools.name: get_shot_map
tools.description: Shot map for a club, player or defence: every located shot with outcome and xG, plus zone totals

tools.name: get_line_movement
tools.description: Snapshots of each sportsbook's line before kick-off

tools.name: get_player_props
tools.description: Anytime goalscorer prices by sportsbook, opening and closing

tools.name: get_prop_history
tools.description: A player's anytime goalscorer price against whether he scored, match by match
